note: Import record for "Tales from Tir-Far's Archive". First written from Tir-Far-Thóinn's Bloodstar (100 characters), then updated from their Klutzbanana almanac, which is newer and larger (134 characters). Where the two disagree the Klutzbanana text wins; where Klutzbanana carries nothing (it has no attribution field, and only 9 of its characters have almanac prose) the Bloodstar text is kept, since an absence is not a conflict. No tags were assigned and nothing was written that neither source says. Klutzbanana files five characters under new names: Tsarina became the Tsarevna, and the four "X (Loric)" Fabled entries became plain names on the loric team; those pages were renamed, so their old URLs 301 to the new ones. Names already used by other creators on the wiki take a -tales-from-tir-fars-archive URL suffix. Characters with no icon are drafts, because a character without one cannot be published (assets/classify.js). Klutzbanana states almanac prose as one markdown blob; its **emphasis** markers are dropped because the wiki's character fields are plain text, but no words are changed.

characters.name: Hawkshaw
characters.ability: You start knowing a player fewer steps from a Minion than they are from the Demon.
characters.lede: The Hawkshaw knows where to look.
characters.quote: I've booked us lodgings on the top floor, next to a respectable dealer in stolen property. As I've heard, good fences make good neighbors.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Wake the Hawkshaw and point to a player with fewer steps to a Minion than to a Demon.

characters.name: Whaler
characters.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play evil character. If the character you know dies, you learn another tonight.
characters.lede: The Whaler knows their quarry, but can't yet see it beneath the waves.
summaryBullets: The Whaler starts knowing one in-play evil character. When that player dies, they learn another evil character.
The Whaler only learns the evil character, not the player.
If the Whaler is drunk or poisoned when they should learn a new character, the Storyteller may show them a not-in-play character.
The Whaler can only learn the same character twice if there are multiple instances of the character.
howToRun: Mark one evil player with the KNOW reminder.
During the first night, wake the Whaler. Show them the character token of the player marked KNOW. Put the Whaler to sleep.

Each time the player marked KNOW dies, mark a new evil player with the KNOW reminder. That night, wake the Whaler, show them the character token of the player marked KNOW, then put the Whaler to sleep.
examples: On the first night, the Whaler is shown "Baron." When Eve, the Baron, is executed, the Whaler learns "Scarlet Woman"
The Whaler is shown "Imp." The Imp kills themselves in the night. The Whaler learns "Imp."
The Whaler learns "Poisoner." The Recluse dies in the night. The Whaler learns "Fang Gu." Neither the Poisoner nor the Fang Gu are in-play.
characters.quote: I know not all that may be coming, but be it what it will, I'll go to it laughing
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Show the Whaler the character of the player with the "KNOWS" reminder
characters.otherNightReminder: If the player with the "KNOWS" reminder died today or tonight, wake the Whaler & show them a new in-play evil character.

characters.name: Postmaster
characters.ability: You start knowing a direction: your living Townsfolk neighbor in that direction learns false info & the other true.
characters.lede: The Postmaster gets people's letters in a muddle.
characters.quote: Neither rain nor snow, nor glom of nit.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If the postmaster died tonight, wake them & point to the neighbor who is getting true info.

characters.name: Orator
characters.ability: You start knowing a rule: if all players on your team follow it, your team wins if an opposing player is then executed.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Duke
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn a character type they are not.
characters.lede: The Duke learns what character type people are... but not quite.
summaryBullets: The Duke chooses a player and learns a character type they are not
This can be any character type except the correct one, travellers, or fabled
If the Duke chooses the same player more than once, you can show them the same character type, or a different one!
examples: The Duke chooses a player who is the Mutant. The Duke learns that this player is not a Townsfolk.
The Duke chooses a player who was the Philosopher but gained the Flowergirl ability earlier that night. The Dreamer learns that this player is not a Minion.

Today, both the Evil Twin and the Artist claimed to be the Artist. That night, the Duke chooses the player who is the Evil Twin. If the Storyteller wanted to help the good team, they could show they're not a Townsfolk. But the Storyteller decides to help evil, so they show the Duke they are not the Demon.
The Duke chooses a player who is the Vortox. The Duke information must be false because the Vortox is in play, so the Duke learns that this player is not the Demon.
characters.quote: I'm sorry, is this some sort of peasant joke I'm too rich to understand?
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Wake the Duke & have them choose a player. Tell them a character type that player is not
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake the Duke & have them choose a player. Tell them a character type that player is not

characters.name: Rockstar
characters.ability: Each night, guess how many players would wake tonight: if correct (once), they instead learn you are the Rockstar.
characters.lede: The Rockstar puts on the best concert Ravenswood Bluff has ever seen.
characters.quote: Wham! Bam! Thank You, Ma'am!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: If the trigger is met, all players that would wake tonight instead learn who the Rockstar is.
characters.otherNightReminder: If the trigger is met, all players that would wake tonight instead learn who the Rockstar is.

characters.name: Talent Scout
characters.ability: Each night, you learn a player with a character the Storyteller was excited to be in play this game until none remain.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Magus
characters.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: today, privately learn their alignment (arbitrary if all other alive Magi did). [+0 to +2 Magi]
characters.quote: But wait - there's myrrh!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Aesthete
characters.ability: Each night*, learn a character the Storyteller believes you should think about.
characters.lede: The Aesthete knows what possibilities to consider.
examples: Alice, the Drunk, thinks she is the Virgin. She is nominated by Bob, who isn't executed. That night, Eve the Aesthete learns "Poisoner."
Alice is the Sailor, who does not die when executed. She declares she is sober. That night, Bob the Aesthete learns "Devil's Advocate."
Eve is the Artist, who learns that 1 + 1 does not equal 2. That night, Alice the Aesthete learns "No Dashii."
tips: If showing the Aesthete a Traveller, Fabled, or Loric, it should be one that's in play.
characters.quote: Caesar adsum iam forte. Brutus aderat. Caesar sic in omnibus. Brutus sic inat.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake the Aesthete & inform them of the character you think they should think about.

characters.name: Bursar
characters.ability: Each night*, if 3 or more unique public statements were made yesterday, learn if most were true.
characters.lede: The Bursar keeps an archive of receipts.
characters.quote: L-O-T-S-O-F-D-R-Y-D-F-R-O-R-C-P-¼-L-L-S
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If 3 or more unique public statements were made, tell the Bursar if most or true

characters.name: Mowltaker
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: chosen Outsiders die & learn you are the Mowltaker. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The Mowltaker clears out the unwanted.
characters.quote: I've been looking for a weird hill to die on, and all the real ones are too far from my house. So this is mine.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake, have them choose a player. If that player is an outsider, kill them and inform them of who the Mowltaker is

characters.name: Fire-Walker
characters.ability: Each night*, Minions wake to choose unique alive good players: you learn who. If you are chosen, you die.
characters.lede: The Fire-Walker learns who the Minions want them to.
characters.quote: One step at a time, one single solitary step.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake each Minion & prompt them to choose a player: If they choose an evil, previously chosen, or dead player, shake your head & prompt them to choose again. Unless the only chosen player is the Fire-Walker, inform them of the chosen good players.

characters.name: Cosmonaut
characters.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a cryptic hint about the gamestate.
characters.lede: The Cosmonaut drifts through the cosmos, deciphering the infinite paisleys of the constellations.
howToRun: Once per day, if the Cosmonaut requests a private chat with you, take them away from the circle so you cannot be overheard. Whisper a cryptic phrase to the Cosmonaut. (If you cannot think of one straight away, either take your time or ask them to come back in a few minutes.)
examples: Alice is the Cosmonaut, & it is day 1 of a Psaliphim game. She learns the hint "Do you hear that?" in reference to the Psaliphim's icon being a bell. On day 2, the Psaliphim has put a Sentry into play. Alice learns "You're being watched."
Bob is the Cosmonaut on the 3rd day. He is told "Sometimes you've got to stop & smell the roses" because the Godfather killed a player last night.

Charlie is the Cosmonaut & learns "I don't like politics." She concludes that this is to indicate that a politician is in play. However, she was told this because the Leviathan was bluffing as the Mayor.
characters.quote: My mother said, to get things done: You better not mess with Major Tom.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Plotter
characters.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a piece of advice that harms the winning team.
characters.lede: The Plotter stands against authority, regardless of who it is.
characters.quote: The last man to enter Parliament with honest intentions was Guy Fawkes
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Geologist
characters.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to say a number: you learn something that has that answer
characters.quote: Put the Rhyolite next to the Olivine, and the Topaz next to the Basalt. I have everything exactly where I want it to be. Almost.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Midwife
characters.ability: Once per game, at night*, 1 player dies & another lives.
characters.quote: There are plenty of people in Ravenswood bluff for whom my face has been the first and last thing they'd ever seen, which probably made the bit in the middle seem quite uneventful by comparison.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Constable
characters.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are a Minion, they die & you regain this ability.
characters.lede: The Constable wields the long arm of the law.
characters.quote: Only crimes can take place in darkness. Punishment has to be done in the light. This is our job; To light a candle in the dark.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Admiral
characters.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to learn the ally who is harming, or the enemy who is helping, your team the most.
characters.quote: I really do not see the signal!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Student
characters.ability: Once per game, visit the Storyteller to learn something you did right. Once, while dead, do so to learn something you did wrong.
characters.lede: The Student learns what they did well, and what they didn't.
howToRun: Twice per game, the Student will ask to use their ability. If they are alive, in private, tell them something they did right. Then, put the Right reminder by the Student token. If they are dead, in private, tell them something they did wrong. Then, put the Wrong reminder by the Student token.
examples: The Student, Julie, almost got the Baron executed yesterday. Julie uses her ability and learns they nominated a Minion.
The Student, Xavier, dies and learns they trusted Bob, the Dreamer. This is because Bob is drunk from the Sweetheart's ability.
Shalya, the Student, correctly guesses in-play evil characters, then later visits the Storyteller and learns she did so.
tips: It's very easy to give very strong info by accident. Be careful out there.
characters.quote: Ahh, I see my mistake. 'Embarazada' does not mean 'Embarrassed'
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Vicar
characters.ability: On your 1st night, choose 1 player for each Minion: if you all live, you're all safe from the Demon.
characters.lede: The Vicar protects their flock.
characters.quote: The Lord is a shoving leopard
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Wake the vicar, and get them to choose players equal to the starting number of minions.

characters.name: Peat-Cutter
characters.ability: On your 1st day, publicly choose a player: if they are an Outsider, they become a Minion on night 3. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
characters.quote: Ge b' e cho dorcha 's a tha a' mhòinteach is cho tiugh 's a tha an ceò, bidh sinn blàth is sàbhailt' fhad 's a bhios mòine againn san teine.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Punk
characters.ability: On the 1st night, before evil info, choose a player: if evil, they swap characters & alignments with a good player.
characters.lede: The Punk inspires people to fight for their cause.
howToRun: During the first night, before Minion info, wake the Punk. The Punk points at a player. Put the Punk to sleep.

If the player the Punk pointed to is evil, swap their character token with a good player's token. One at a time, wake each swapped player, show them the YOU ARE info token and their new character token, then put them to sleep.
examples: On the 1st night, Alice the Punk chooses Eve the Imp. Eve becomes the good Empath and Bob (the former Empath) becomes the evil Imp.
Eve the Punk chooses Bob, who is good. Nothing happens.
Bob the Artist is turned into the Punk on night 2 by the Pit-Hag. Since it is not the first night, she does not choose someone
characters.quote: I fought the law (The law won)
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Wake the Punk & get them to choose a play. If applicable, swap that player's character & alignment. Put the Punk to sleep.

characters.name: Boxer
characters.ability: You are safe from Minions. If chosen by one, learn each other's characters.
characters.lede: The Boxer never loses a fight.
howToRun: If a harmful Minion effect would affect the Boxer, it doesn't. (Use your best judgement)
At night, if a Minion chooses the Boxer, immediately show the Minion the Boxer token. Put the Minion to sleep. Wake the Boxer, and show them the Minion's character token. Put the Boxer to sleep.
If a Minion chose the Boxer today, Wake the Minion & show them the Boxer token. Put the Minion to sleep. Wake the Boxer, and show them the Minion's character token. Put the Boxer to sleep.
JINXES
examples: On the first night, the Poisoner chooses the Boxer. The Boxer is not poisoned, learns the Poisoner chose them, and the Poisoner learns they chose the Boxer.
The Assassin chooses the Boxer. The Boxer dies, learns the Assassin chose them, and the Assassin learns they chose the Boxer.
There is a Xaan in play with 2 Outsiders. On night 2, the Boxer is not poisoned.
tips: "Safe" is quite poorly defined when it comes to the multitudinous effects Minions can produce. As such, the Storyteller is free to designate any and all effects as "harmful", so long as they make it clear to their group.
characters.quote: Still a man hears what he wants to hear, and disregards the rest.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: If a Minion chose the Boxer, wake both & inform them of each other's characters
characters.otherNightReminder: If a Minion chose the Boxer, wake both & inform them of each other's characters

characters.name: Furze-Burner
characters.ability: You start by choosing 3 players: chosen Minions become Outsiders until either your 3rd day or you die.
characters.lede: The Furze-Burner lights the moors.
characters.quote: Sevow' a-dhelher ha kebmer with a'n mog, vaw, na wra eythin plegya dhe dhen gwadn y golon. Emava ow mires en garow, martesen, bes thera vy ow clerya an rosow ma hirra vel ty dhe anella, ow lesky an coth m'alja an skyll glas trovya spas lowr dhe vewa pan vo gwenton ow tos.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Have the Furze-Burner choose 3 players: Any chosen Minions become Outsiders.
characters.otherNightReminder: Change the 1 token to the 2 token, or the 2 token to the 3 token.

characters.name: Farrier
characters.ability: You start by choosing a Townsfolk: the Pixie learns them instead. If it is not-in-play, you register as it to the Pixie. [+the Pixie]
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Rat-Catcher
characters.ability: When the Demon kills you or a Minion they learned, they learn a Minion. If that Minion lives on the final day, good wins.
characters.lede: The Rat-Catcher keeps the plague contained... until they die.
howToRun: If the Rat-Catcher is killed by the Demon, place the INFESTED reminder token next to a Minion. Wake the Demon. Point to the player marked INFESTED, show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token, then the Rat-Catcher token.
If it is the final day, and a Minion marked INFESTED is alive, declare that the good team has won, and end the game.
examples: Alice, the Rat-Catcher, dies to the Demon at night. Eve, the Cerenovus, gains this ability. The Demon kills Eve, and Bob (the Harpy) gains the ability.
Eve, the Rat-Catcher, dies to the Demon at night. Alice, the Witch, gains the ability. She curses herself, nominates, and dies. Nothing happens.
Bob, the Rat-Catcher, is alive on the final day. Nothing happens.
characters.quote: The best way to catch a rat is to treat it like a king. Draw those young sirs to the table, and treat them to a platter of fancy cheeses, perhaps a cracker or two. The plan is now in motion.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: Add the reminder token "Infested" to a Minion

characters.name: Consort
characters.ability: When you learn that you are executed, publicly choose a new player: if they're evil, you're executed at dusk tomorrow instead.
characters.quote: Don't you want to hear how the story ends?
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Milkmaid
characters.ability: If you die at night, learn 1 evil player. [+0 or +1 Milkmaid]
characters.lede: The Milkmaid learns who soured the milk.
howToRun: Jinxes
characters.quote: Oo's yer dad?
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If a Milkmaid died, wake them and point to an evil player.

characters.name: Action Hero
characters.ability: If you die at night, an opposing player you nominated this game dies (unless either team would win).
characters.lede: The Action Hero takes their rivals down with them.
howToRun: If the Action Hero died tonight, choose an opposing player who they nominated: If neither team would win, mark them with the DEAD reminder. In the morning, announce them as dead (Do not say why.)
characters.quote: Does this dining chair have an ejector seat, and if so, how?
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If the Action Hero died tonight, choose an opposing player who they nominated: If neither team would win, mark them as "DEAD" and announce them as such in the morning.

characters.name: War Hero
characters.ability: If you are executed, your nominator's allies don't wake tonight.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Arkan Sonney
characters.ability: If you find me, make a wish. 1 Outsider knows a clue to where [I'm hidden. +1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The Arkan Sonney brings good fortune to anyone who catches them.
tips: Experimental (obvs!)
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Dean
characters.ability: If the Demon is the only living evil player, learn who they are tonight.
characters.lede: The Dean needs silence to complete their work.
characters.quote: You don't need a miracle, you just need five minutes without distractions. As it turns out, thinking is a lot easier when nobody's yelling.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If all evil players who are not the Demon are dead, wake the duke & point at the Demon player

characters.name: Troll
characters.ability: If the Demon would kill you at night, a Minion dies instead. If you left your seat in the town square today, you're drunk until dawn.
characters.lede: The Troll has unimaginable strength, but turns to stone during the day.
howToRun: Each day, check to see if the Troll left their seat to talk with another player (Asking for rules clarifications with the Storyteller does not count, nor does leaving their seat for unrelated reasons, e.g. to use the bathroom). If they did, mark the Troll player with the DRUNK reminder token. If you are unsure, wake the Troll player and ask them — they must answer honestly.

During the night, if the Demon attacks the Troll, and the Troll is not drunk, the Troll remains alive & a Minion dies instead — put the Demon's DEAD reminder token by that character token instead of the Troll, and put a shroud on that character token instead of the Troll.
At dawn, declare that the player marked DEAD died at night. (Do not say how they died.)
characters.quote: May the dawn take you all, and be stone to you!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If the Troll left their seat today, they are drunk. If they would die to the Demon, mark a minion as "DEAD" instead

characters.name: Hippie
characters.ability: If an evil player nominated another today, you die tonight.
characters.lede: The Hippie can't stand infighting, even amongst their enemies
characters.quote: That's just like, your opinion man...
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If an evil player nominated another today, mark the hippie as "DEAD"

characters.name: Biker
characters.ability: If all (& only) Outsiders agree, they become Bikers [+0 to +1 Outsider]
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Kaiser
characters.ability: If no-one died yesterday, you alone decide who is executed from now on.
characters.quote: Where my Guards appear, there is no room for democracy. The enemy must be vanquished completely and I will dictate the peace terms at the point of my soldiers' bayonets.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Two-Headed Calf
characters.ability: All Townsfolk are sober, healthy, & get true info. On your 2nd night, you (& only you) die.
characters.lede: The Two-Headed Calf makes the world a better place for as long as they are with us.
characters.quote: And as he stares into the sky, there are twice as many stars as usual.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: All Townsfolk are sober, healthy, & get true info
characters.otherNightReminder: On your 2nd night, you (& only you) die.

characters.name: Landsknecht
characters.ability: The 1st player the Demon kills who is fewer steps from them than from you becomes evil & you learn this.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Curarist
characters.ability: The Demon's neighbors register as good Outsiders to Townsfolk. Once per game, during the day, learn an Outsider. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The Curarist induces visions to detect the Demon's presence.
characters.quote: Not all visions deceive. Some merely reveal what you’ve been too blind to notice.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Lemming
characters.ability: Good players who nominate you become Lemmings. If 1 Lemming dies, all do.
characters.lede: The Lemming makes people follow them... sometimes off a cliff.
characters.quote: Let's play Follow-the-Leader! I'll go first!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: Inform all players who became Lemmings today that they did so. If one died, kill all others.

characters.name: Ornithologist
characters.ability: Minions & Demons don't learn their characters until you die & wake without prompt. [Minions & Demons draw blank tokens]
characters.lede: The Ornithologist hides the evil team from themselves.
characters.quote: My mist nets are set up, I have my binoculars, I have my sandwiches. All I need to do now is wait.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If dead, inform minions & demons of their characters

characters.name: Official
characters.ability: Minions know an Official is in play. Each night*, if the Demon wasn't nominated today, all Minions are drunk until dusk.
characters.lede: The Official sows distrust in the evil team.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Orchard Keeper
characters.ability: There are an even number of Outsiders in play. [+0 or +1 Outsiders]
characters.lede: The Orchard Keeper likes neat and even rows.
howToRun: Jinxes
characters.quote: Get it? Because pairs sounds like pears? Oh, nevermind.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Rabbi
characters.ability: 1 Minion has the Golem ability: if they nominated today, they learn this.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Mentor
characters.ability: 1 good player can't die. If you guess who (once), they become a Mentor when you die.
characters.lede: The Mentor trains someone in their ways.
characters.quote: What a guy!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Escape Artist
characters.ability: Executions on you fail if you're nominated by an opposing player. 1 player registers falsely to you.
characters.lede: The Escape Artist causes executions to fail if evil players want them dead.
characters.quote: Never tell the audience how good you are, they will soon find out for themselves.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Mariner
characters.ability: Once, at night*, you may register as dead until 3 dusks pass, & learn a fact each night, but die if a player guesses you (once).
characters.quote: Listen, Stranger! Storm and Wind, a Wind and Tempest strong! For days and weeks it play'd us freaks, like Chaff we drove along. Listen, Stranger! Mist and Snow, and it grew wond'rous cauld: and Ice mast-high came floating by as green as Emerauld.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Believer
characters.ability: Each night, learn a player: you are mad they are evil or you might be executed.
characters.lede: The Believer is paranoid.
howToRun: Each night, wake the Believer and point to a player. Mark that player with the MAD reminder.

At any time (even at night), if you believe that the Believer is not mad about that player being evil, then you can decide to execute the Believer. Declare this to the group. They die - mark them with a shroud.
If you execute them during the day before the normal execution happens, go to the night phase. (There is a maximum of one execution per day.)
characters.quote: Did you see it? I saw it... It crashed in the woods. I saw it... It's one of us. I saw it... It's you.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Point to a player.
characters.otherNightReminder: Point to a player.

characters.name: Sabre Dancer
characters.ability: Each night*, become the alignment of the player you nominated today: if they are the Demon, you are drunk instead.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: White Elephant
characters.ability: Once per game, at night, the Demon chooses who you are. If you died today, they may choose another tonight. [You don't start in play]
characters.lede: The White Elephant is a burden.
characters.quote: I bequeath thee with my finest elephant. Sure, it is loud, always hungry, and smells worse than a drunkard’s bile. But think of how jealous your friends will be!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show the white elephant token, then ask if they wish to use the ability. If so, get them to choose a player, then change that player into the White Elephant.
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show the white elephant token, then ask if they wish to use the ability. If so, get them to choose a player, then change that player into the White Elephant.

characters.name: Everyman
characters.ability: You think you're another good character. If you publicly resign, you win. [All other players are secretly Storytellers]
characters.lede: The Everyman's life is a lie.
summaryBullets: The Everyman draws a different character token from the bag, but is secretly the Everyman. All other players receive blank (or adjacent) tokens, & learn who the Everyman is on the first night.

All other players are Storytellers. This is a secret, therefore, to the Everyman (i.e. all players) you can lie about or announce anything that makes the Everyman think the other players are not Storytellers (fake Fearmonger announcements, Virgin executions, night kills, &c).
The ability that the Everyman thinks they have doesn’t work, but the main Storyteller pretends it does. It is just as if this player is the Drunk.
If the Everyman publicly resigns, they win. If only two players live, the Everyman loses.
If a player publicly resigns, and they are not the Everyman, their team loses.
howToRun: While setting up the game, add one character token that is not the Everyman, and all other tokens that would enter the bag are blank (or adjacent) tokens. Several Everyman character tokens have been provided for this reason.

During the first night, mark the only character on the grimoire with the IS THE EVERYMAN reminder. Wake all other players. Point to the player marked IS THE EVERYMAN and show the Everyman character token. Put all other players to sleep.
Treat the Everyman as if they were drunk. They wake when their character would wake, may get false information, etc.
At any point during the game, if a player publicly announces that they would like to resign, and they are marked IS THE EVERYMAN declare that good wins. Otherwise, declare that their team loses.

The Everyman is a complex character, and is recommended for experienced Storytellers. It is your job to work with the other 'Storytellers' to create a fun game for the Everyman. In order to create an enjoyable experience, the Everyman should be able to deduce their true identity.

Optional Rule: If a player attempts to publicly resign, you may give other players a chance to change their mind. This gives other players a chance to intervene in the event that the player resigning is not the Everyman.
examples: Tir is the Everyman who thinks they are the Fortune Teller. After receiving arbitrary information all game, she publicly resigns. Good wins.
Haunted is the Flowergirl. Despite other players trying to convince him not to, he publicly resigns. Good loses.
characters.quote: And in case I don't see ya, good afternoon, good evening, & goodnight
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Húdié
characters.ability: You think you're a Townsfolk. Once per game, you & some players wake to lose your abilities, even if dead. The Demon learns who.
characters.lede: The Húdié thinks they're a townsfolk until their dreams bring about a shocking revelation...
howToRun: While setting up the game, before putting character tokens in the bag, remove the Húdié token and add a Townsfolk character token. Add the Húdié's IS THE HÚDIÉ reminder token to the Grimoire. Put the swapped Townsfolk character token in the bag, not the Húdié character token.

While preparing the first night, put the Húdié's IS THE HÚDIÉ reminder token by any Townsfolk character token, changing that player's character to the Húdié. They are now an Outsider, and do not have the ability of this Townsfolk character. (But they think they do.)
Treat the Húdié as if they were drunk. They wake when their townsfolk would wake, may get false information, &c.

Once per game, at night, mark any number of players with the Húdié's BUTTERFLY reminder token. Wake all players marked (& the Húdié) and show them the "This character selected you” info token and the Húdié token, then put them back to sleep. That same night, wake the Demon and show them the "This player is" info token and the Húdié token, then point to all marked players before putting them back to sleep.
tips: While you can wake the Húdié on any night, and wake any number of players, do keep in mind how this effects the game. Waking more players or the Húdié waking on an earlier night are more damaging than waking fewer players or the Húdié waking on a later night. Be warned!
characters.quote: Five more minutes, please? You wouldn't believe the dream I just had. I mean, you were there, and you were there, and you, and you, and you were there....
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake the Húdié at some point & tell them & some townsfolk they're the Húdié. Tell the demon too pretty please <3

characters.name: Orc
characters.ability: You might be good or evil & don’t know which until you stop being a living Orc, or it's the final night. [All Outsiders are Orcs]
characters.lede: The Orcs form a horde, but don't know what team to play for.
howToRun: While setting up the game, replace all Outsider tokens in the bag with Orc tokens.
During the first night, decide how many Orcs will be evil, and flip the Orcs' character tokens upside down to represent that the Orcs are evil.
If an Orc dies or changes character, wake the Orc. If the Orc is good, show them a thumbs up. If the Orc is evil, show them a thumbs down. Put the Orc to sleep.
On the final night, wake all remaining Orcs separately. If the Orc is good, show them a thumbs up. If the Orc is evil, show them a thumbs down. Put the Orc to sleep.
examples: Eve is an Orc. She is evil. There are no other Outsiders.
Alice is an Orc. She is good. When she dies, she learns this.
Alice, Bob, and Eve are all Orcs. On the first day, they form a blood pact and go around the town square saying "Orc Orc Orc". On the final night, they learn they are good.
tips: Because Orcs do not know their alignment for most of the game (and when they do learn it, they are usually dead), it is acceptable to make 2 Orcs evil, although it is advised to not make more evil Orcs than that.
characters.quote: Looks like meat's back on the menu, boys!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Vanguard
characters.ability: You know who the Demon is. [Outsiders are secretly evil; Demons & Minions are secretly good. +? Outsiders]
characters.quote: If the landslide is big enough, even square pebbles will roll.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Kipperer
characters.ability: When you die, 1 Minion becomes an unlisted character & you learn which.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Draper
characters.ability: If you died today or tonight, Minions may choose Townsfolk to gain the ability of & register as.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If the Draper died today or tonight, wake the Minions & prompt them to choose townsfolk characters to gain the ability of & register as.

characters.name: Barometz
characters.ability: If you died today or tonight, 2 players equidistant from you become evil Minions & learn the Demon. [-1 Minion]
characters.lede: The Barometz bears vile fruit.
howToRun: During setup, remove one Minion token from the bag and add a Townsfolk in its place.

If the Barometz dies, mark 2 players equidistant from them with SPROUTS TONIGHT reminders. That night, wake the chosen marked players (together or separately). Show the YOU ARE info token, then the Minion token. Show the YOU ARE info token, then give a thumbs down. Point at the Demon. Replace their character tokens with the Minion tokens and put the new Minions to sleep.
characters.quote: Cradled in ſnow and fann'd by arctic air / Shines, gentle Barometz! thy golden hair; / Rooted in earth each cloven hood deſcends, / And round and round her flexile neck ſhe bends; / Crops the grey coral moſs, and hoary thyme, / Or laps with roſy tongue the melting rime.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If the Barometz died today or tonight, 2 players equidistant from them become minions, turn evil, and learn the demon.

characters.name: Equerry
characters.ability: If you died today or tonight, the Demon gains the ability "If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes your character" & learns this.
characters.lede: The Equerry lets the Demon flee if the horses are loose.
characters.quote: Calm down, Thunderfoot. I don't know what's got you all spooked like this, it's almost like you see something I don't...
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If the Equerry died today or tonight, the demon gains the ability to starpass. Tell the demon this.

characters.name: Gobemouche
characters.ability: If you are mad that any information is false, you might be executed.
characters.lede: The Gobemouche can't disagree.
characters.quote: It is more from carelessness about truth than from intentional lying, that there is so much falsehood in the world.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Kabuki
characters.ability: If you're mad you're a Townsfolk, you might become one. [+0 or +1 Outsider, most Outsiders are Kabuki]
characters.lede: The Kabuki must put on a show.
howToRun: Before the game starts, while setting up the bag, replace at least half of the Outsider tokens with the Kabuki. You can also replace up to 1 Townsfolk token.

At any point, if you think a Kabuki has successfully upheld madness to your liking, you can change their token out for a Townsfolk one. At the start of the next night (or immediately, if it is night), tell them their new character.
JINXES
examples: Alice & Eve are Kabuki. Alice is mad as the Investigator, while Eve is mad as the Village Idiot. Neither of them know the other is a Kabuki.
On night 4, the Storyteller agrees that Luis (the Kabuki) has caused enough confusion by being mad as the Bounty Hunter, and turns them into the Sage.
characters.quote: *Giggle*
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Canary
characters.ability: If you are the 1st player to die the way you did, something bad happens & you may visit the Storyteller to learn what.
characters.quote: The cruellest irony is a miner who dies so his canary might live.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Quaaltagh
characters.ability: If you draw this token, you may redraw, but learn false info once. Townsfolk become leftover evil characters. [+1 Townsfolk in the bag]
characters.lede: The Quaaltagh wishes everyone a happy new year.
characters.quote: Blein Vie Noa! Slaynt vie, bea veayn, beeal fliugh as baase ayns Mannin!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Distribute tokens but don't send them out. Find the player with the Quaaltagh token, ask them if they want to redraw. If they do, mark them with the 'FIRSTFOOT' reminder. Randomly choose a character distributed after the Quaaltagh, and make the marked player them. Then, inform the player who had the token the 'FIRSTFOOT' marked player is now that they drew the Quaaltagh token, and repeat. Then send out tokens. If there is 1 fewer evil at the end, 1 townsfolk becomes it.
characters.otherNightReminder: You may chose to make any players marked "FIRSTFOOT" learn false info, and remove their reminder token.

characters.name: Fenoderee
characters.ability: If the Demon was nominated today, they may choose if they swap characters with a Minion tonight.
characters.lede: The Fenoderee takes requests literally.
howToRun: During the day, if the Demon is nominated, mark them with the SWAPS TONIGHT reminder. That night, wake the Demon. Show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token, then the Fenoderee token. The Demon either nods or shakes their head. Put the Demon to sleep. Remove the SWAPS TONIGHT reminder. If the Demon nodded their head, swap the character tokens of the Demon and a Minion player of your choice. One at a time, wake each swapped player, show them the YOU ARE info token and their new character token, then put them to sleep.
characters.quote: I must say, I simply don’t understand this outrage. You wished for the killer to go away. All I did was answer
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If the Demon was nominated today, wake them and ask if they want to swap characters with a minion: If they do, they swap characters with a minion of your choice.

characters.name: Margrave
characters.ability: If only Outsiders & Demons live, Demons turn good & living Outsiders turn evil (even if dead).
characters.lede: The Margrave lets Outsiders steal the Demon's victory.
characters.quote: We all have our own reasons for wanting this foul Demon dead. My reason? Competition.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

customBoxes.content: Thank you Ella for helping me fix up the final version

characters.name: Yeoman
characters.ability: If there’s only 1 Yeoman in play, 1 Townsfolk is drunk. Otherwise, 1 Outsider is. [+0 or +1 Yeoman.]
characters.lede: The Yeoman needs a drinking buddy.
characters.quote: Hey, hey, stop me if you've *hic* heard this one before "There once was a man from Nantucket..."
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

customBoxes.title: Credits
customBoxes.content: This was made in conjunction with Xhorian, flavoured as "Rice Farmer" for their script.

characters.name: Spacefarer
characters.ability: If an ally nominates & executes the Demon, your team loses. When you learn that you died, choose a living player to gain this ability.
characters.lede: The Spacefarer saves the day!.. or else.
characters.quote: If you find yourself in a fair fight, you didn't plan properly.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Scullery Maid
characters.ability: The Demon has a not-in-play Minion ability, even if you die. You both know which.
characters.lede: The Scullery Maid lets another Minion ability enter play.
howToRun: While setting up the game, before putting character tokens in the bag, make any changes that are indicated in brackets on the Demon's two character abilities. Afterwards, place this second character token by the Demon character token.

During the 1st night, wake the Scullery Maid and the Demon separately. Show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token, then the Scullery Maid token, then the Minion token. Place this second character token by the Demon character token.
Treat the Demon player as if they had this character ability, as well as their own Demon ability.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Tell the Scullery Maid what ability the Demon has. Tell the Demon the ability too.

characters.name: Explorer
characters.ability: The Demon's ability has been changed & they know what it is. You know the change, but not the ability.
characters.lede: The Explorer knows how they change the Demon's ability, but not what from.
howToRun: While setting up the bag, decide if the change to the Demon's ability will affect setup. If it will, make any relevant changes to the bag. Then, write the Demon's new ability on a piece of paper, or on a phone.
During the first night, wake the Demon. Show this ability, then put them to sleep. Wake the Explorer, show them the part of the ability they changed, then put them to sleep.
From now on, even if the Explorer is dead, drunk, poisoned, or leaves play, run the Demon's new ability instead of their old one.
examples:
The No Dashii's ability has been changed to "Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 alive Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned." the Explorer learns the word "Alive"
The Explorer has changed the Leviathan's ability to "[...] After day 4, evil wins." they learn "Day 4",
The Storyteller changes the Vortox's ability to "[...] Good abilities yield false info. [...]". The Explorer learns "Might"
characters.quote: And of course, the thing you must not do if the ape is enraged, is the Macarena.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Tell the Explorer the change

characters.name: Shrew
characters.ability: The 1st dawn you're dead, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are not executed today, your team loses at dusk.
characters.lede: The Shrew curses those who let her die.
howToRun: The 1st time the Shrew player wakes up after being declared dead, they must declare that they are the Shrew and then point at any player. (Give them time.) If the player they chose is not the player executed that day (or no-one is executed), the game ends and the evil team wins. If they are, the game continues.
If the Shrew chooses a player (who is not the Demon), and the Demon is executed (ending the game), the good team wins.
In the strange situation the Shrew is evil, it is the evil team who loses when their choice is not executed.
characters.quote: And that's what she is, the Queen of Refuse! So bow down to her if you want, bow to her! Bow to the Queen of Slime, the Queen of Filth, the Queen of Putrescence! Boo! Boo! Rubbish! Filth! Slime! Muck! Boo! Boo! Boo!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Vigilante
characters.ability: Players who are mad you're evil might die at night.
characters.lede: The Vigilante does the right thing... right?
characters.quote: Villains are everywhere, that's how I know that I'm the hero!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: If someone was "mad" the Vigilante was evil, they might die at night.

characters.name: Ostrich
characters.ability: Players might not learn things they otherwise should.
characters.quote: Well, I don't remember 2012, but I heard the world would turn to hell. Compared to that, I'm doing well. So I pray to God it really did.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Tsarevna
characters.ability: Players who aren't mad you're the Tsarevna might be executed.
characters.lede: The Tsarina demands recognition.
characters.quote: Да, до свидания, darling.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Unicorn
characters.ability: Minions start knowing an improbable condition & you know a clue to it. If it happens (once), you're executed, even if dead.
characters.lede: The Unicorn is being hunted.
howToRun: Jinxes
characters.quote: You may have been young and foolish then, but you're old and foolish now! See clear! Don't let the glamour get you! See what's in front of your eyes! It's a damn great horse with a horn on the end!
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Tell the Minions the condition. Tell the Unicorn a clue.

characters.name: Vagrant
characters.ability: You're only in-play if you shouldn't be, & vice versa. [+1 or -1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The Vagrant travels around.
howToRun: While setting up the game, before putting the character tokens in the bag, decide if one of the Outsiders is going to be the Vagrant. If it is, remove a Townsfolk token from the bag, and add an Outsider token. If they aren't, remove 1 Outsider token and add a Townsfolk token.
If the bag would be made with 0 Outsiders, remove a Townsfolk token and add the Vagrant. If all on-script Outsiders would be in play, remove the Vagrant token from the bag, and add a Townsfolk token.
examples: It is a 7 player game, and there should be no Outsiders in play. Alice is the Vagrant.
It is an 8 player game. If there is a Vagrant, there must be another Outsider. If there isn't, there must be no Outsiders.
It is a 9 player game with a Baron. There must be 3 Outsiders in play, and none can be the Vagrant.
characters.quote: If every hope abandons you, there's peace in that, you know? And when you hit rock bottom, there's only one way left to go.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Cavalier
characters.ability: At your 1st dusk, publicly choose 3 players: if a good player you chose is executed, your team loses, even if dead.
characters.quote: For king and country! And gold, as it happens. Silver's good too, and I've been partial to decent malt when the occasion allows...
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Playwright
characters.ability: You start knowing another script. Each night*, choose which script is being played (you keep this ability).
characters.quote: Destiny is funny stuff, you know? You can't trust it. Often you can't even see it. Just when you think you have it cornered it turns out to be something else- coincidence, maybe, or providence. You bar the door against it, and it's standing behind you. Then, just when you think you have it nailed down, it walks away with the hammer.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.lede: The Playwright tells their own tale.
summaryBullets: Each night, other than the first, the Playwright chooses which script is being played.
If the script changes, players are now the character on the new script in the same position as their old character.
This is not, technically speaking, a character change, so you are not a new instance if you get switched multiple times.

characters.name: Chameleon
characters.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play good character & they know a Chameleon is in play: your ability is based on theirs.
characters.lede: The Chameleon blends in.
characters.quote: Loving would be easy if your colours were like my dreams: Red, gold and green, red, gold and green
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Inform the Chameleon what character their ability is based on, and what it is. Wake the good player

characters.name: Clairvoyante
characters.ability: You start knowing a Grimoire &, even if you die, your team wins if it becomes real. The 1st time something goes wrong, it doesn't.
characters.lede: The Clairvoyant guides town until they're exactly where she wants them to be.
characters.quote: A prophecy that can be thwarted by any common farmer is undeserving of the name. But darling, you’ll find your fate will not be forsaken so easily
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Charlatan
characters.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: their info is nonsensical until dusk.
characters.lede: The Charlatan cons people out of their information.
howToRun: Each night, wake the Charlatan. They point to 2 players. Mark them with the CONNED reminders. Put the Charlatan to sleep.

If either player with the CONNED reminder would learn information, wake them at their normal place in the night order. Instead of telling them their information, tell them something completely nonsensical.
examples: The Charlatan has chosen Alice the Empath. She is woken up and learns '3', then is put back to sleep.
The Charlatan has chosen Bob the Fortune Teller. He is woken up to choose 2 players, then is told 'Green'.
The Charlatan has chosen Eve the Chambermaid. She is woken to choose 2 players. The Storyteller hands her a vase before putting her to sleep.
characters.quote: Left cup, centre cup, right cup... Right cup, centre cup, left cup... Left cup, centre cup, no cup... You follow?
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Wake & have the Charlatan choose 2 players; Mark those players with the 'Conned' reminder. Until dusk, give both of those players nonsensical information
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake & have the Charlatan choose 2 players; Mark those players with the 'Conned' reminder. Until dusk, give both of those players nonsensical information

characters.name: Dullahan
characters.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: all players learn their character. Tomorrow night, they die.
characters.lede: The Dullahan foretells of people's death.
characters.quote: Where paths end and names are forgotten, the rider still knows the way. What loses its head loses its mercy, and what hears the hooves too late is already counted among the dead.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Luddite
characters.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: their ability becomes slightly worse until you die, & they learn this.
characters.lede: The Luddite sabotages town's machinery.
howToRun: Each night, wake the Luddite. The Luddite points to a player. Put the Luddite to sleep. Mark the player as SABOTAGED. Invent a slightly worse ability for that player, and write it down on a piece of paper, or on a phone.
Wake the player marked SABOTAGED. Show them their new ability. Put them to sleep.
If the Luddite dies, wake all players marked SABOTAGED separately and show them their character tokens. Put them to sleep.
examples: Alice, the Luddite chooses Eve, the Steward. She learns her ability is now "You start knowing 2 players, at least 1 of whom is good"
Eve, the Luddite chooses Bob, the Courtier. She learns her ability is now "Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 2 nights & 2 days."

Bob, the Luddite, chooses herself. She learns her ability is now "Each night, you may choose a player: their ability becomes slightly worse until you die, & they learn this. The Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently."
tips: The Luddite can require a lot of work for the Storyteller, and isn't a particularly strong Minion. Its raison d'être is simply its existence as a very funny character, similar to Charlatan.

OPTIONAL RULE: I can see the argument to be made that outsiders should have their abilities made worse for the good team. Feel free to run it this way! The main reason I went with the ruling I did was through comparison with poisoner.
characters.quote: You better back down, or there'll be another accident involving me, the toaster, the waste disposal, and this fourteen pound lump-hammer.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Watchmaker
characters.ability: Each night, choose up to 3 players: if their ability would yield information before dusk, they act twice and learn false info once.
characters.quote: A man with 1 watch knows what time it is; A man with 2 is never sure- especially if I made them.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Watcher
characters.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: if they do not nominate & execute a player tomorrow, or are mad you chose them, they die that night.
characters.quote: DO YOU TAKE US AS A JOKE? YOU HAD ONLY ONE RULE, AND YOU MADE A MOCKERY OF IT. THIS WILL NOT GO UNPUNISHED.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Decimus
characters.ability: Each night*, you may choose that a random player (not the Demon) dies.
characters.quote: Alea iacta est.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Mawmett
characters.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller & offer something: the Storyteller offers something in return.
characters.quote: As above, so below.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Basilisk
characters.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a signal: players who see it tonight die.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Ronin
characters.ability: You are a Traveller too. If you are exiled, your team wins. [You discussed this before setup, -? to +? Outsiders]
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Spin Doctor
characters.ability: You are the Bounty Hunter's 1st target. If they're mad you're evil, they're poisoned, even if you're dead. [+the Bounty Hunter]
characters.quote: Rumour is information distilled so finely that it can filter through anything. It does not need doors and windows - sometimes it does not need people.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Moreau
characters.ability: You know X. [You choose which players are which Outsiders. Up to X Outsiders]
characters.quote: An animal may be ferocious and cunning enough, but it takes a real man to tell a lie
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Wake the Moreau to choose which players are which outsiders

characters.name: Governess
characters.ability: When a player is nominated, you may publicly forbid that nomination. You may only forbid the nomination of 1 evil player per day.
characters.quote: Just because they're a vile, man-eating monster doesn't mean being polite goes out the window. Righteousness is no substitute for good manners.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Carpenter
characters.ability: If you die by execution, your nominator becomes a not-in-play evil Minion tonight.
characters.lede: The Carpenter forces those who kill them to live with their guilt.
characters.quote: אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Scorpion

characters.name: Perkeo
characters.ability: If the Demon kills you at night & the next player to die during the day is evil, your team wins.
characters.lede: The Perkeo practices stillness.
howToRun: If the Perkeo is killed by the Demon, place the HOLLOW reminder token next to the Perkeo. If the next player to be executed is evil, the Perkeo's team wins.
examples: Alice is the Perkeo, and is killed by the Imp on night 2. The Imp is executed on day 2. Evil wins.
Eve is the Poisoner. She is executed today, after the Demon killed the Perkeo last night. Evil wins.
Bob is the Alchemist with the Perkeo ability. She was killed by the Demon last night. The Psychopath is executed today, and good wins.
characters.quote: Let's play a game: It's called watching me play the fool. I know you like to play- in fact I think you're making up the rules.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Fraudster
characters.ability: If all dead good players have their vote token on the final day, your team wins.
characters.lede: The Fraudster makes town cash out early.
characters.quote: Trust me, your money's not safe in their hands. The system is rigged, the banks are bleeding you dry- cash out now before they lock the doors and leave you with nothing.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Buggane
characters.ability: If a living Outsider is nominated & you claim to be the Buggane, their team loses if they are not executed. [+1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The Buggane drives town to kill those who don't belong.
summaryBullets: If anyone nominates a living Outsider, and the Buggane claims to the the Buggane, evil wins if the Outsider is not today's executee.
Anyone can claim to be the Buggane, but if they don't have the ability it can't cause evil to win.
The Buggane wins if the Outsider is not executed that day, even if the Demon or the Buggane themselves are.
If the Buggane uses their ability on multiple Outsiders on the same day, evil wins if none of them are executed.
howToRun: While setting up the game, before putting character tokens in the bag, remove a Townsfolk character token and add an Outsider character token.

If the Buggane claims to be the Buggane when a living Outsider is nominated (and before voting begins), declare that this player has claimed to be the Buggane, so that all the group hears. Put the CORNERED reminder by the Outsider token.
If a living Outsider is marked CORNERED and none were executed, then declare that evil wins.
examples: Alice is the Buggane. Alice nominates Eve, who is the Klutz, and she claims to be the Buggane. After votes are counted, Eve is not 'about to die'. Evil wins.
Alice is the Butler. Bob nominates Alice, and Eve, the Buggane, claims to be the Buggane. Alice is not executed, and evil wins.
tips: The Buggane has a simple but effective power - forcing the town to spend one of their precious executions to execute an Outsider.
Find the Outsiders! Your whole ability runs on this principle, and if you use your ability on a Townsfolk, it's unlikely very much good will come of it.

Claim to be the Buggane! Your ability doesn't do anything if you aren't loud about it, so you better start killing off those Outsiders. After all, if you can trigger your ability then the game ends if an Outsider isn't executed, and you're no Outsider!

Stay silent! The Buggane's biggest strength is later into the game, when executions become a much more valuable resource for the good team. If you can keep Outsiders alive until 5 or fewer players live, then you've almost certainly won the game for sure!

Use your ability on other evil players you want executed. If you'd like to draw attention away from your Demon, or gain some benefit from executing a particular evil player (for example, if they are the Boomdandy), you can get them executed if they claim to be an Outsider - provided the good team doesn't call their bluff.

If you're a different evil character, you can always claim to be the Buggane to get rid of a pesky Outsider or to waste town's time. The good team doesn't know you aren't the Buggane, after all, and it's usually much safer to assume the worst and tank the hit rather than to take the risk and call your bluff

characters.name: Samedi
characters.ability: The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead. Living votes don't count & a majority isn't required. Vote tokens aren't spent.
characters.lede: The Samedi makes the dead dance to their rhythm.
characters.quote: In the silence came the drumming, making the music that had gone before seem as insignificant as the cluttering of crickets. This was the real blood music; all other music that had ever been written was merely a pitiful attempt to sing along.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Cambium
characters.ability: The 1st Minion to die (even you) becomes a Minion character of your choice, then keeps their ability.
characters.lede: The Cambium preserves the dead.
characters.quote: If all the mountains were of silver and gold, What would they profit a man who lives in constant fear of death? Hence there cannot be in the whole world anything better than our Medicine, which has power to heal all the diseases of the flesh.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

jinxes.reason: If the Vigormortis kills a Minion, activating the Cambium's ability, the Cambium may choose to use their ability on the next Minion to die instead.

characters.name: Operative
characters.ability: Players who are mad they learned info about you might be poisoned.
characters.quote: Deep in the desert in '47, I was there. Remember Roswell? No? You can thank me later.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Goatherd
characters.ability: Players who raise their hand at night turn evil. If this gives evil a majority, followers turn good & your team wins.
characters.lede: The Goatherd grants town the opportunity to defect- unless everyone does.
characters.quote: For sheep are stupid, and have to be driven; but goats are intelligent, and need to be led.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.firstNightReminder: Announce that the goatherd calls for followers, whether the goatherd is in play or not.
characters.otherNightReminder: Announce that the goatherd calls for followers, whether the goatherd is in play or not.

characters.name: Jarl
characters.ability: Outsiders are drunk, even if you die at night. [+3 Outsiders]
characters.lede: The Jarl brings their raiding party with them.
characters.quote: We're tearing up this place tonight- Literally.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Yad al-Jawza
characters.ability: From the 3rd time a player is named, any players who do so might be executed.
characters.lede: The Yad al-Jawza strikes down those who speak the names of others.
howToRun: The first time any player's name is spoken, mark the Yad al-Jawza with the ONCE reminder token. The second time this happens, mark the Yad al-Jawza with the TWICE reminder token. The third time, mark them with the SHOWTIME! reminder token, and you may execute the player who said the name.
If the Yad al-Jawza is marked with SHOWTIME!, you may execute any player who says a players name.
examples: Alice is the Noble. On the first day, she says her Noble pings are "Bob, Charlie, and Eve." She is executed.
Eve is the Steward. She says her ping is wearing a skirt. Multiple people are wearing skirts, so this isn't a 'name.'
Bob, the Goblin, says "Bob Bob Bob Bob Bob" all day, every day. This is annoying, but nothing happens.
tips: "Name" is pretty vacuous, so I suggest ruling it as an "unambiguous moniker"- that is, if you can say they are referring to a single person without any doubt, that's a name!
You should be executing frequently, the 'might' is to stop evil from controlling every execution.
characters.quote:
Najam, najam, najam, far. 
What are we but wounds and scars?
Blinding vision, I can't cry.
Ghost of brilliance, yet to die.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Colour
characters.ability: Only you know your ability. Outsiders know you're in play & may guess it each day: they learn how close they are. [+1 Outsider]
characters.quote: ...not quite mustard, not quite plum, not quite red, not quite green, not quite white, not quite blue...
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.lede: The Colour is indescribable.
summaryBullets: You can have any ability the Storyteller wants.
Outsiders know the Colour is in play, and may make guesses (a la Amnesiac) each day
Each Outsider gets 1 guess each day.

characters.name: Premotira
characters.ability: Each dusk*, if most players raise their hand & a Minion was executed today, or most don't & you were, evil wins. After day 5, evil wins.
characters.quote: Odd thing, ain't it... you meet people one at a time, they seem decent, they got brains that work, and then they get together and you hear the voice of the people. And it snarls.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Artimort
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die at dawn.
characters.quote: This whole time I've been playing chess, while you've all been playing chess... like idiots.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.lede: The Artimort is 1 step ahead.

characters.name: Myrkkymato
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die & poison 1 good neighbor until dusk.
characters.lede: The Myrkkymato kills & poisons its victims in a single bite
characters.quote: Great holes secretly are digged where earth's pores ought to suffice, and things have learnt to walk that ought to crawl.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
characters.otherNightReminder: Wake and have them choose a player: They die, & mark one of their good neighbors with the "poisoned" reminder.

characters.name: Fawn
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If a Minion died today, choose 3 instead.
characters.lede: The Fawn mourns the death of its young.
characters.quote: In the forest there lay an ominous sight; if you see a young deer, dare not ye approach it, for its mother lies waiting
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Cacophony
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. Outsiders nominated today might be executed. [+1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The Cacophony causes quite the commotion.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Automata
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. On the final day, if any Minions live, good wins. [+1 Minion]
characters.lede: The Automata require clockwork precision.
characters.quote: Twenty-eight teeth interlocked, intertwined. Bismuth and bronze, beryl and brass. Twenty-eight teeth interlocked, intertwined.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: Behemoth
characters.ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: 1 dies. If they're different character types, both do. [-1 to +1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The Behemoth has massive killing power if it can find the sinners.
characters.quote: A fire's hatred // For nothing is sacred // I will make them feel my pain.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn

characters.name: King in Yellow
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you lose, players mad you are in play lose with you. [-1 Outsider]
characters.lede: The King in Yellow drives people to madness.
tips: The King in Yellow is my attempt to make "Loss-con Madness" actually work, but like all characters of this calibre, players need to be okay with the Storyteller making their best judgement as to what constitutes "being mad that the King in Yellow is in play". Madness is a tricky thing to judge, and sometimes players will think they weren't mad when the Storyteller does.
characters.quote: Forget not Carcosa, where the black stars hang in the heavens; where the shadows of the thoughts of men grow long in the afternoon; where the twin suns go down into the Lake of Hali: and thy mind shall bear for ever the memory of the Pallid Mask.
characters.creator: Tir-Far-Thóinn
